description: This file is a Markdown documentation source describing the API for the 'Tracing' class in Playwright, including its methods, options, usage examples, and relevant notes. It is not executable source code but documentation content for developers referencing the Playwright API.

classes.name: Tracing
classes.description: API for collecting and saving Playwright traces, including methods to start, stop, and manage trace chunks and groups.

methods.name: Tracing.start
methods.description: Starts tracing on a browser context, with options to include screenshots, snapshots, source files, and a trace title. This method initializes trace recording for subsequent actions.

methods.name: Tracing.startChunk
methods.description: Begins a new trace chunk within an existing trace session. Used to segment traces into multiple files for different phases of a test or action sequence.

methods.name: Tracing.group
methods.description: Creates a trace group to logically group related actions within a trace, aiding in better trace organization and readability in Trace Viewer.

methods.name: Tracing.groupEnd
methods.description: Ends the most recently created trace group, marking the end of that group in the trace.

methods.name: Tracing.stop
methods.description: Stops the ongoing trace recording and optionally saves the trace to a specified file.

methods.name: Tracing.stopChunk
methods.description: Stops recording a trace chunk started with `startChunk`, saving it to a specified file.
